name: Exp_XRSIDeMarker_Histogram
summary: This EA is an Expert Advisor that trades based on the XRSIDeMarker histogram indicator, which combines RSI and DeMarker oscillators into a composite momentum signal. It generates buy and sell signals when the histogram crosses defined threshold levels, indicating overbought or oversold momentum conditions. The EA systematically enters and exits positions based on these crossover events.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XRSIDeMarker直方图指标进行交易，该指标将RSI和DeMarker振荡器组合为复合动量信号。当直方图穿越设定的阈值水平时，产生买入和卖出信号，指示超买或超卖动量状态。EA根据这些穿越事件系统地开仓和平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于将RSI（相对强弱指数）和DeMarker指标融合为一个复合直方图振荡器，从而产生更灵敏的动量信号。入场条件为：当直方图从下方穿越买入阈值时开多仓，当直方图从上方穿越卖出阈值时开空仓，利用双重振荡器的共振来提高信号可靠性。出场条件包括直方图反向穿越阈值、止损和止盈的触发，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险边界。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数来控制每笔交易的风险回报比，但缺少对总体持仓风险的限制机制。整体策略属于动量反转类型，在极端动量区域寻找反转机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on fusing RSI (Relative Strength Index) and DeMarker indicators into a composite histogram oscillator, producing more responsive momentum signals. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the histogram crosses above the buy threshold level, and a short position is opened when the histogram crosses below the sell threshold level, leveraging the resonance of dual oscillators to improve signal reliability. Exit conditions include the histogram crossing back through the threshold, stop loss and take profit triggers, ensuring each trade has a defined risk boundary. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters, supporting fixed lots or equity-proportional dynamic lot calculation. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop loss and take profit parameters to control the risk-reward ratio per trade, but lacks mechanisms for limiting overall portfolio exposure. The overall strategy is a momentum-reversal type, seeking reversal opportunities at extreme momentum zones.

parameters.description_en: Enable money management dynamic lot size

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade for dynamic lot sizing

pros: 结合RSI和DeMarker双重振荡器，信号共振提高了入场可靠性
直方图形式直观展示动量强度和方向，便于参数优化
支持固定手数和动态资金管理两种仓位模式，灵活性好
pros_en: Combines RSI and DeMarker dual oscillators, signal resonance improves entry reliability
Histogram format intuitively displays momentum strength and direction, facilitating parameter optimization
Supports both fixed lot and dynamic money management position sizing modes, offering good flexibility
cons: 缺乏总体持仓风险控制，多信号连续触发时可能过度开仓
默认止损止盈为0，未设置时存在无限风险暴露
单一时间框架分析，缺少多周期确认机制，容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: Lacks overall position risk control, potentially over-trading when consecutive signals fire
Default stop loss and take profit are 0, creating unlimited risk exposure when not configured
Single timeframe analysis without multi-timeframe confirmation, prone to false signals
improvements: 添加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H1信号触发时要求H4趋势方向一致
增加最大持仓数量限制和日内最大亏损限制，防止极端行情下的过度风险暴露
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., requiring H4 trend alignment when H1 signals fire
Add maximum position count limit and daily maximum loss limit to prevent excessive risk exposure during extreme market conditions

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，未手动设置时风险无限
缺少最大持仓限制，连续信号可能导致过度开仓
振荡器在强趋势市场中容易产生反复虚假信号
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit are zero, creating unlimited risk if not manually set
No maximum position limit, consecutive signals may lead to over-trading
Oscillators easily generate repeated false signals in strong trending markets
